  • Active strikes: Kuwait airport struck by Iranian drones (Al Jazeera). Israel/US strike reported on a drinking-water tank in SW Iran (TASS).
  • Airspace & flights: Regional airports closed: Iran, Iraq, Syria. FlightScan: 400 aircraft in region; 1 military aircraft tracked (RCH1807).
  • IDF activity: IDF: Chief of General Staff LTG Eyal Zamir spoke with Central Command Commander MG Avi Bluth after an unspecified incident near the area. Investigation/command review ongoing.
  • Northern Border: Daily Hezbollah activity continues (ongoing exchanges; local alerts remain high).
  • Domestic unrest: 21 arrested in Tel Aviv and Haifa during anti-war protests. Settler attacks on multiple Palestinian villages; 2 reported injured, no arrests reported.
  • Diplomacy / pauses: US announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET — citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. Tactical note: first pause (5 days) was violated hours later; risk of violations remains high.
  • Regional dynamics: Iran allowing Hormuz transit for select states (Russia, India, China) while restricting others — preserves leverage and divides responses.
  • Risk note:
  • 🟢 Good News: US pause and Pakistan mediation create a limited diplomatic window.

Bottom line:

Threat assessment: Escalating.

Situation Brief — Day 27 (last 2 hrs)

  • Active strikes/sirens: Multiple wide Israeli/US strike waves on Tehran (IDF: 3rd wave today). Houthi second-wave drones/cruise missiles launched toward southern Israel. Missiles struck Eilat. Kuwait airport hit by Iranian drone strikes.
  • Northern Border / Lebanon: Hezbollah active daily. Israel striking Hezbollah targets in Beirut and the Beqaa. Hezbollah-affiliated brigades in Iraq announce stepped-up missile and drone launches toward Israel.
  • Maritime / Hormuz / Red Sea: Iran allows passage for Russia, India, China; blocks others. Houthi Red Sea attacks continue, raising shipping-disruption risk.
  • Air / logistics / strike tempo: Flight scans show Iran, Iraq, Syria airports closed. Reports of Israeli KC-707 tankers refueling F-15s over Syria. US reportedly fired ~850 Tomahawks in ~4 weeks (~25% pre-war TLAM inventory).
  • Infrastructure & humanitarian: Drinking-water tank and a 10,000m3 reservoir hit in Khuzestan/Haftgel and a reservoir in SW Iran. Strikes reported near Masoudieh barracks, Soltani Alley and by Evin prison. Civilian protests in Tel Aviv/Haifa — 21 arrested. Settler attacks on Palestinian villages; two injured.
  • Diplomacy / pauses: Trump announced a 10-day pause on energy strikes until Apr 6 20:00 ET, citing an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan acting as mediator.
  • Tactical context: Third Tehran strike today. High Tomahawk expenditure signals attrition pressure on US strike inventory. Airport closures constrain regional air operations.
  • 🟢 Good News: Interceptions reported over Erbil. Multiple incoming threats intercepted before major population impact.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
2.he:
תדריך מצב — יום 27 (שעתיים אחרונות)

  • פעיל: מתקפות/אזעקות: גלות תקיפה רחבות של ישראל/ארה"ב על טהראן (לפי צה"ל: גל שלישי היום). הוואות'י שיגרו גל שני של כטב"מ וטילים לעבר דרום ישראל. טילים פגעו באילת. שדה התעופה בכוויית הופל בעקבות התקפות רחפנים איראניות.
  • גבול צפון / לבנון: חזבאללה פעיל מדי יום. ישראל תוקפת מטרות חזבאללה בביירות ובבקאא. פלגים פרו־איראניים בעיראק מדווחים על הגברת שיגורים לעבר ישראל.
  • ימי / הורמוז / ים האדום: איראן מאפשרת מעבר לספינות רוסיות, הודיות וסיניות; חוסמת אחרות. התקפות הוואות'י מעלות סיכון לשיבושים במשלוחים ימיים.
  • אוויר / לוגיסטיקה / קצב תקיפות: דפוסי טיסות מצביעים על סגירת נמלים באיראן, עיראק וסוריה. דיווחים על מטוסי תדלוק KC-707 של ישראל מעל סוריה. ארה"ב שיגרה כ-850 טומאהוק בארבעה שבועות (~25% מהמאגר לפני המלחמה).
  • תשתיות והומניטרי: מיכל מים ובריכה של 10,000 מ"ק הותקפו בח'וזסתאן/הפתגל ובדרום־מערב איראן. תקיפות ליד מחנה מסודיייה, סמוך לכיכרות סולתאני וסמוך לכלא איוון. הפגנות בתל אביב וחיפה — 21 מעצרים. מתנחלים תקפו כפרים פלסטיניים; שניים נפצעו.
  • דיפלומטיה / הפסקות: טראמפ הכריז על הפסקת פגיעות באנרגיה למשך 10 ימים עד 6.4 בשעה 20:00 ET, בטענה לבקשת איראן; איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת.
  • הקשר טקטי: גל שלישי על טהראן היום. צריכת טומאהוקים גבוהה — לחץ על מלאי התקיפה. סגירת נמלים מקשה על יכולות אוויריות אזוריות.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: דיווחים על יירוטים מעל ארביל. גלות נכנסות יורטו לפני פגיעה באוכלוסייה גדולה.
  • הערכת איום: במגמת הסלמה.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hours)

  • Active: Israeli/US airstrikes on multiple Iranian targets; missiles struck southern Israel (Eilat); interceptions reported over Erbil.
  • Air campaign: IDF reports a third wide-scale wave across Tehran today. Strikes reported on Masoudieh barracks, a residential building on Soltani Alley, near Evin Prison, a reservoir in Haftgel (Khuzestan) and a drinking-water tank in SW Iran.
  • Long-range ops: Israeli KC-707 tankers refueled F-15s over Syria. Flight scans show Iran/Iraq/Syria airports closed. US reportedly fired ~850 Tomahawks in four weeks (~25% of pre-war inventory).
  • Northern border: Hezbollah active daily. Iraq-based Hezbollah brigades announce stepped-up missile and drone launches. IDF striking Hezbollah positions in Beirut and the Beqaa.
  • Regional strikes/defense: Houthis claim a second wave of drones/cruise missiles toward southern Israel; AP reports a Houthi missile attack. Missiles impacted Eilat. Interceptions reported over Erbil (Iraq).
  • Homefront: 21 arrested in Tel Aviv and Haifa during anti-war protests. Settler violence reported against Palestinian villages; two injured.
  • Diplomacy/pauses: US announced a second 10-day pause on Iran energy strikes (deadline Apr 6). Pakistan mediating. Iran denies direct talks. First pause was violated.
  • Logistics/impact: Reduced commercial flights. Military flights active in the region. Iraqi airspace is being used or contested during strikes.
  • 🟢 Good News: Multiple interceptions reported (Erbil). Some incoming threats were stopped.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

Day 27 — Iran‑Israel campaign: Key developments (last 24h)

  • Active strikes / sirens:
    • Multiple wide‑scale waves of strikes on Tehran — IDF says 3rd wave today.
    • Missile strikes hit southern Israel — Eilat reported hit.
    • Kuwait airport damaged by Iranian drone strikes.
    • Reports of water infrastructure damaged in Khuzestan (Haftgel) and a drinking water tank hit in SW Iran.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon/Iraq):
    • Hezbollah active daily. Israeli strikes reported on Beirut and Beqaa.
    • Hezbollah brigades in Iraq say they will increase ballistic missile and drone launches toward Israel.
  • Red Sea & Houthis:
    • Houthi forces launched at least a second wave of drones/cruise missiles toward southern Israel.
    • Houthi missile attack on Israel raising risk to Red Sea shipping routes.
  • Hormuz & shipping:
    • Iran permits passage for Russia, India, China; blocks others. Navigation access now selective — raises routing and insurance risks.
  • Diplomacy & pauses:
    • Trump announced a second 10‑day pause on Iranian energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian Government request."
    • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First 5‑day pause was violated hours after it began.
  • Military logistics & attrition:
    • Reports claim ~850 Tomahawks fired in ~4 weeks (~25% of pre‑war U.S. inventory) — suggests depletion pressure on long‑range strike stockpiles.
    • Airspace closures reported in Iran, Iraq, Syria; tanker and fighter movements noted over Syria toward Iran.
  • Domestic / Civil:
    • 21 arrested in Tel Aviv and Haifa during anti‑war protests.
    • Settler attacks on Palestinian villages reported; at least 2 injured.
  • Interceptions / Good defensive news:
    • Interceptions reported over Erbil. Air defenses continue to intercept inbound threats.
    • Pakistan mediation and announced pause create a narrow diplomatic opening.
  • 🟢 Good News: Successful interceptions reported over Erbil; international mediation (Pakistan) and a formal pause window exist.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
